findings.claim: Sudoku is ranked the #1 most profitable puzzle-book type on KDP, cited for universal appeal, language-agnostic content, automated generation, and $8-$12 price points.
findings.source_ref: kdpeasy: 12 KDP Puzzle Book Types Ranked by Profit (2026 Data)
findings.note: Secondary aggregator claim (kdpeasy is a KDP-tools vendor); dollar figures unverified against primary marketplace data.

findings.claim: The 'Bold and Easy' large-print format is cited as the fastest-growing puzzle trend in 2026 (claimed +45% YoY) and commands a $1-$3 price premium over standard formats.
findings.source_ref: kdpeasy: 12 KDP Puzzle Book Types Ranked by Profit (2026 Data)
findings.note: Growth percentage is a vendor claim with no primary source; treat direction as a hypothesis, not the exact figure.

findings.claim: A 'Sudoku Variations' segment (Killer, Samurai, Jigsaw) exists as a live adult sub-category, appearing repeatedly as book titles in marketplace search listings.
findings.source_ref: ddg search: 'killer sudoku samurai jigsaw sudoku variety puzzle book for adults'
findings.note: Evidence is result-listing titles (existence of titles), not sales data.

findings.claim: A kids sudoku segment using 4x4 / 6x6 (and stepping up to 9x9) grids for children roughly ages 4-12 is live, appearing repeatedly as book titles in marketplace search listings.
findings.source_ref: ddg search: 'sudoku for kids 4x4 6x6 mini sudoku puzzle book children'
findings.note: Result-listing titles evidence; age framing (4-8, 6-12, 8-12) varies by title.

findings.claim: The primary sudoku buyer is described as adult, with average buyer age skewing 35-70; large-print/senior and kids formats are called out as growing sub-segments.
findings.source_ref: kdpeasy: sudoku niche page + puzzle-types ranking
findings.note: Vendor market page; age band is a stated range, not primary demographic data.

findings.claim: Large-print sudoku for seniors is a distinct, essential-format audience; senior-care-facility bulk purchases are cited as a demand driver and 8.5x11 large print is called essential for this audience.
findings.source_ref: kdpeasy: sudoku niche page (Bestsellers to study)
findings.note: Bulk-purchase claim is unverified vendor assertion; the large-print-for-seniors format itself is corroborated by search listings (F-004 pattern).

findings.claim: Common sudoku trim sizes on KDP are 6x9 and 8.5x11 (8.5x11 for large-print/senior), on white 60lb paper, with typical page counts of 100-200 pages.
findings.note: Advisory only per rule 20; the design-policy engine is authoritative at project init.

findings.claim: Volume-anchored formats ('1000 Sudoku Puzzles') are a live pattern that sustains higher list prices ($14.99-$16.99) via perceived value.
findings.source_ref: kdpeasy: sudoku niche page (Bestsellers to study)
findings.note: Price band is a vendor estimate; treat as pricing hypothesis, not committed price.

findings.claim: Difficulty-tiered series (Easy / Medium / Hard / Expert as separate books) is a recommended structure that increases per-buyer revenue vs a single mixed-difficulty book, and color-coded difficulty (blue/green/red) creates a collectible set.
findings.source_ref: kdpeasy: sudoku niche page (pricing math + cover tips)
findings.note: Strategy advice from a KDP-tools vendor; directionally consistent across the page.

findings.claim: The sudoku niche is characterized as High demand and High competition, with a typical price band of $6.99-$10.99 and a BSR sweet spot around top 2,500 in Books > Humor & Entertainment > Puzzles & Games > Sudoku.
findings.note: Vendor-reported; BSR/price bands not verified against live Amazon data (manual tier blocked).

findings.claim: High-converting sudoku title formulas follow patterns like '[Difficulty] Sudoku for [Audience]: [Number] Puzzles to [Benefit]', 'Large Print Sudoku Puzzle Book for Seniors: [Number] Puzzles with Solutions', 'Sudoku for Beginners: [Number] Step-by-Step Puzzles with Tips & Full Solutions', and 'Daily Sudoku ... for Brain Health'.
findings.note: Title templates; ensure any concrete counts/difficulty match verified generated content before use.

findings.claim: High-intent sudoku keyword ideas include: 'sudoku puzzle book for adults', 'large print sudoku for seniors', 'easy sudoku for beginners', 'hard sudoku puzzles', 'expert level sudoku', 'brain games for seniors', 'daily sudoku puzzle book', 'medium difficulty sudoku book', 'sudoku with solutions', '1000 sudoku puzzles book'.
findings.note: Rights-safe generic terms; none are trademarks. Validate against channel tag limits at listing time.

findings.claim: Sudoku books list under the Amazon browse path Books > Humor & Entertainment > Puzzles & Games > Sudoku; corresponding BISAC is the Games & Activities > Puzzles family (e.g. GAM013000 Puzzles / GAM022000 Sudoku).
findings.source_ref: kdpeasy: sudoku niche page (BSR path); BISAC code inferred
findings.note: Browse path is from the vendor page; exact BISAC code should be confirmed via the BISAC finder / official list before listing.

findings.claim: Marketplace guides warn that reusing identical generator templates and shipping difficulty-inconsistent puzzles harms reviews; the recommended fixes are original puzzles with unique solution paths, consistent per-book difficulty, and back-of-book solutions with clear puzzle numbering.
findings.note: Directly aligns with house rules: code-generated + code-verified uniqueness/solvability, labeled difficulty must match measured difficulty, back-only answer keys.

findings.claim: Standard-difficulty sudoku at ~150 pages on 6x9 white paper prints for approximately $3.05 and is commonly listed at $7.99-$9.99; large-print 8.5x11 at ~100 pages prints for approximately $3.75 and lists at $9.99-$11.99.
findings.note: Print-cost and price figures are vendor estimates; pricing is deprioritized and nullable per skill. Do not commit any live price.

findings.claim: Amazon 'sudoku puzzle book for adults' returns over 1,000 results, and the top-ranked paperbacks for that head term are adjacent titles (Murdoku, Murdle, a Highlights kids jumbo activity book) rather than pure adult sudoku — the exact head term is crowded and partly captured by non-sudoku logic/activity brands.
findings.note: unverified · amazon · 2026-07-31. Prices in the paste were AUD 27.23/27.23/28.39 but for non-sudoku titles, so not a clean adult-sudoku price signal. Implication: differentiate below the head term (difficulty/audience long-tail).

findings.claim: Amazon 'large print sudoku for seniors' returns ~392 results; top results skew to large-format trims around 7.5x9.25 to 10.75x7.75 inches and prices roughly AUD 12-24, though the very top organic hits are large-print word search packs rather than sudoku.
findings.note: unverified · amazon · 2026-07-31. Corroborates large-print/oversized-trim norm [F-007]; exact 8.5x11 dominance not confirmed (competing sizes seen).

findings.claim: Amazon 'sudoku variations killer samurai jigsaw' returns ~153 results; the best-ranked dedicated title ('Sudoku Variations Puzzle Book for Adults: Killer, Samurai, Jigsaw, Diagonal X and Classic') has 127 ratings at ~AUD 14.27 — a real but modest-sized differentiated segment.
findings.note: unverified · amazon · 2026-07-31. Sizes the Variations segment beyond title existence [F-003]; smaller than the core adult/senior niches.

findings.claim: Amazon '1000 sudoku puzzles book' top paperbacks list around AUD 18.57-23.63 (e.g. Nova Publishing, SUDOKU LADDER, Kampelmann) — volume-anchored titles do command a higher price tier than standard single-difficulty books.
findings.note: unverified · amazon · 2026-07-31 (prices in AUD). Corroborates the volume-anchored higher-price pattern [F-008]. Pricing is a hypothesis; no live price committed.
